properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony pointed at chain_reflow, 2026-08-12, while working out bottom-up system-of-systems: "made me think of chain-reflow... might be worth re-analyzing that repo and doing a search for what reflow2 already has in this topic."

⚠️ THIS NODE IS THE INGEST OF `docs/chain-reflow-nuggets.md`, which is one of the four nuggets files on Anthony's ingest-then-delete list (inward-facing docs become graph, then go). It held reflow2's adoption plan for chain_reflow and NOTHING IN THE GRAPH RECORDED IT — searching for "chain reflow nuggets touchpoint matryoshka" returns nothing above 12.5, all of it unrelated. A stale inward-facing tracker holding knowledge the graph does not have is exactly why that list exists.

═══ THE AUDIT, 2026-08-12: six nuggets, planned vs actual ═══

  MATRYOSHKA / MISSING-INTERMEDIATE      adopt (now)        ✅ BUILT — hierarchy.rs; `missing_intermediate_level` fires in both hierarchy_issues and detect_gaps
  CORRELATION VS CAUSATION               adopt (now, schema) ✅ BUILT — `basis` + `validation_status` on inference edges, and the schema still credits chain_reflow by name
  CREATIVE LINKING (guarded healer)      adopt (concept)     🛑 BUILT as `generate_bridge`, then RETIRED 2026-08-10
  SoS TOUCHPOINT DISCOVERY               adopt (MEDIUM)      ⬜ the word "touchpoint" appears NOWHERE in the codebase
  ORTHOGONALITY ASSESSMENT               later               ⬜
  INTERACTIVE EXECUTOR                   later               ⬜

═══ FINDING 1 — TOUCHPOINT DISCOVERY IS HALF SHIPPED UNDER OTHER NAMES AND HALF OUTLAWED ═══

The nuggets doc specifies it as: "allow Project↔Project links, and a touchpoint-discovery pass that PROPOSES cross-project `Interface`/`DEPENDS_ON` edges (standard technical matching first; creative linking only for orthogonal, guarded). The merged graph is then diagnosed/healed like any other."

⭐ THE 2026-07 PLAN IS PARTLY FORBIDDEN BY A 2026-08 RULE. `req:a-repair-suggestion-never-proposes-fabrication` (accepted, shipped v0.28.0) removed `generate_bridge` precisely because proposing an edge that asserts a relationship nobody stated is fabrication. A pass that PROPOSES cross-project DEPENDS_ON edges is that, across an ownership boundary, where it is worse — the asserted relationship is between two designs whose owners never agreed to it.

BUT THE PERMITTED HALF EXISTS, under two different names:
  - "standard technical matching first" -> `pair_designs`, which reports `candidates` and states outright that uncertain name matches are "CANDIDATES to ask about, never actions".
  - "the merged graph is then diagnosed like any other" -> `compose_and_analyse`, which imports theirs alongside yours in memory and runs the ORDINARY checks over the whole, attributing findings ours / theirs / seam.

⇒ TOUCHPOINT DISCOVERY IS NOT UNBUILT THROUGH NEGLECT. Its safe half shipped as two differently-named tools and its unsafe half was deliberately outlawed. That is a better outcome than the plan, and it should be recorded as such rather than sitting on a roadmap as a debt.

📌 CREATIVE LINKING'S COMPLETE ARC IS WORTH KEEPING: adopted as a concept (2026-07), built as `generate_bridge`, retired as fabrication (2026-08-10). heal.rs still carries the comment "NO SUGGESTION, DELIBERATELY. `generate_bridge` used to sit..." — an idea taken from another project, built, and then argued back out on a rule the receiving project later derived. Chain_reflow also carries `validate_merged_architecture.py`, written because "Chain Reflow workflows create merged architectures but lack automated validation" — the same job `compose_and_analyse` now does, which confirms the merged graph was always meant to be validated AS A WHOLE.

═══ FINDING 2 — THE ACTIONABLE ONE: A MIRRORED DESIGN OCCUPIES NO RUNG ═══

`Component.level` already runs `component ▸ subsystem ▸ system ▸ system_of_systems ▸ enterprise`. SO SYSTEM-OF-SYSTEMS IS ALREADY A MODELLED RUNG, and `missing_intermediate_level` is pure level arithmetic over CONTAINS/DEPENDS_ON **between Components**.

🛑 BUT A MIRRORED DESIGN ARRIVES AS A **PROJECT** CONTAINING COMPONENTS (measured 2026-08-12: 1 Project, 6 Components, 5 Interfaces, 1 Artifact, with 5 CONTAINS edges from `proj:flo2`). **A PROJECT OCCUPIES NO RUNG ON THAT LADDER.** So the cross-graph black box sits outside the level system entirely, and matryoshka detection structurally CANNOT see across an ownership boundary — not because the analysis is missing, but because the thing on the far side is not levelled.

⇒ THE QUESTION, and it is one sentence: **does a mirrored Project present as a Component at some level, or does the ladder extend to Projects?** Answer it and matryoshka recurses across ownership boundaries using the detector that already exists.

This is also exactly what `req:recursive-black-box-decomposition` demands in its own closing line — "an arbitrary-depth nesting that is exercised beyond two levels" — and the two had never been connected.

OPTIONS, none taken:
  A — A MIRRORED PROJECT PRESENTS AS A COMPONENT at a stated level, chosen by the mirroring side. Cheapest: no schema change, the existing detector works immediately. EXPENSIVE: the level is the HOST's judgement about someone else's design, which is an assertion about them they never made — the same class the fabrication rule guards.
  B — EXTEND THE LADDER TO PROJECTS, so level arithmetic spans node types. Truthful — a Project genuinely is a bigger box than a Component. EXPENSIVE: a schema change touching the one property the matryoshka detectors are built on.
  C — THE MIRRORING SIDE DECLARES THE RUNG ON THE MIRROR, not on the foreign node — a property of the LINK rather than of either design. Fits "foreignness is a property of the node" and keeps the host's judgement on the host's side of the line. EXPENSIVE: the link is not yet a first-class object, which is gap 1 of the linking audit.
  D — LEAVE IT. Cross-graph composition is analysed by `compose_and_analyse` and needs no levels. EXPENSIVE: then `req:recursive-black-box-decomposition` is satisfiable within a graph only, and the bottom-up SoS reading Anthony is reaching for stays out of scope.

NOT DECIDED.
properties.name: OPEN — chain_reflow's six nuggets audited: does a MIRRORED DESIGN occupy a rung on Component.level, or is the cross-graph black box outside the ladder forever?
properties.rationale: Captured because pointing at chain_reflow turned up an adoption plan that existed only in an inward-facing doc slated for deletion, and auditing it against the code changed two statuses: touchpoint discovery is half-shipped under other names and half-outlawed by a rule derived after the plan was written, and creative linking has a complete adopted-built-retired arc worth keeping. The actionable residue is one sentence — a mirrored design occupies no rung on Component.level, so the matryoshka detector cannot cross an ownership boundary — which is the precise blocker under the cross-graph reading of req:recursive-black-box-decomposition.
